tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon pilot is consistent with a monotone concave response, but the fixed covariates and narrow trajectory do not identify the governing law well enough to meet fresh-confirmation tolerance. Acquire the lower-cost open-branch probe to separate candidate mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a saturating/concave response model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations vary only u_now; s_grad, x_now, memory, and horizon are effectively fixed, so coupled input effects and alternative concave mechanisms remain underidentified.
More points along the same narrow input slice are less useful than a discriminating probe that opens a distinct branch.
It is explicitly irrelevant and costly.
